# Vendored: do not edit

A copy of [agent-skills](https://github.com/ghostaff-ai/agent-skills/tree/35af0bccf842df141555ec52277b05fb90a1f300),
commit `35af0bccf842df141555ec52277b05fb90a1f300`.

Refresh it with the workspace's `vendor-agent-skills.py`, never by hand: a local edit is
